title: Scaling
hook: When load grows you can buy a bigger machine — or more identical smaller ones.

steps.caption: Vertical scaling: send everything to one increasingly powerful box.

nodeCaptions.big: Simple mentally. Ceiling: the biggest machine you can rent, and a single point of failure.

steps.caption: Horizontal scaling: split load across many smaller servers (usually with a balancer).

nodeCaptions.s2: Needs the app to handle being one of many (shared nothing / careful state).

takeaways: Vertical = bigger machine. Horizontal = more machines.
Horizontal scaling pairs naturally with load balancers.
State (sessions, uploads) is what makes horizontal hard.

quiz.question: Adding more identical servers behind a balancer is…
quiz.explanation: Scale out = horizontal. Scale up = vertical.
